positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributing to Disney Streaming's fraud prevention and decision platform protecting Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+ from fraudulent subscriptions and transactions using Kotlin, Spring Boot, and AWS services.

* Develop features for a real-time evaluation API integrating with rules engines, ML models (SageMaker), and 15+ upstream services.

* Contribute to self serve application designed for product teams to integrate with our rules service without the need for help from developers.

* Integrate AWS services including DynamoDB global tables, Kinesis, S3, and SageMaker for distributed fraud detection

* Maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Spinnaker, and Kubernetes with multi-region deployments across US and EU

* Write comprehensive tests using Cucumber and maintain code quality standards via SonarQube

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Recently started working on AWS Jam, an interactive game designed to teach customers how to use AWS any and all AWS Services.  Jam offers a UI for both event participants and administrators, who also have the ability create new challenges with CloudFormation that can be added to events.  Daily duties involve working on both the game's backend and frontend, as well as integrating with different AWS APIs to spin up an environment for the game participants to problem-solve in.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: In response to the pandemic, Hearst is launching a new local deals platform for aggregating sales at brick and mortar stores in the cities surrounding its 20+ newspapers.  I am assisting with building the Wordpress site that will display the deals as well as creating a microservice that ingests sales and coupons from various external APIs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop for internal platform for users to create advertising campaigns and assign ads to zones on one of various publishers' sites.  Daily work involves building on PHP MVC framework, writing a predictions app using AngularJS and working with APIs to track analytics.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Daily responsibilities include working developing features for the internal project tracker, fixing front end bugs, pitching new APIs and libraries to be integrated with http://NYCEDC.com, http://www.nycruise.com/, http://www.bklynarmyterminal.com/, and other microsites we manage.

company.name: New York City Economic Development Corporation

positions.title: Freelance
positions.description: Data gathering, Database management, User Interface Coding, Creating admin tools.  Use of PHP, MySQL, javascript, jQuery, etc.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Built computers, cleaned out old hardware, and fixed software and operating system issues.

projects.title: Beacon for Spotify
projects.description: App for Android that allowed users to choose a song from Spotify's expansive library and request it at the local establishment(bar, restaurant, club, etc).  If the establishment used Spotify, then it would create a music playlist containing the requested songs and similar ones it choose with it's decision engine.

projects.title: Phosaics
projects.description: Social web app I created to generate photo mosaics out of your pictures and share them with your friends.
